page.layout: Printed page 298. One narrow column of marginal notes in the left margin, one short note per entry. The main text block beside them is not in this part.; One column of consular lists, with the year of each group in the middle; the years 1541–1548 stand in the right margin beside them; the catchword "Eltet" stands at the foot right.

p.note: Geldri, & Balthasar Esensis bellum compositū renovant in Frisia Orientali.
Præfectura vetus a milite Comitis Ennonis fœde afflicta. Arx Grethana Geldris dedita & pax instaurata.
Groninga injuriis Geldricis irritata in fidem domus Burgundicæ concedit cū agro vicino Dammo-na a Georg. Schenk-io capta.
Proceres Geldriæ adversus principem suum insurgentes, eum conditionibus circumscribunt.
Efena a Bremen-sibus capta, & Bal-thasar ac Comes En-no mortui.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Schenk-io" (the word is split across the line end and the letters are hard to separate); "vortuus" (probably mortuus, but the first letter is uncertain). Some macrons and the hyphen in "Dammo-na" may be less clear than the letters around them. The years 1533–1540 stand in the middle of the table; 1541–1548 in the right margin. The centre-bottom "Eltet" is taken as catchword.
